candidates.change_summary: Change require(msg.value == 1 ether) to require(msg.value == 2 ether) so lockInGuess requires a different payment amount.
Change guesses[msg.sender].block = block.number + 1 to guesses[msg.sender].block = block.number + 2 so the lock block is different and settle behavior changes.
Change guesses[msg.sender].guess = hash to guesses[msg.sender].guess = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(hash)) so the stored guess differs.
Delete guesses[msg.sender].guess = hash so guess is never stored (defaults to 0).
Delete guesses[msg.sender].block = block.number + 1 so block remains 0 and lockInGuess can be called again without settle.
Delete require(guesses[msg.sender].block == 0) so lockInGuess can be called multiple times overwriting the guess.
Insert guesses[msg.sender].block = block.number after storing the guess so settle always sees current block number instead of the intended prior block.
Swap the order of storing guess and setting block so block is set before guess, which does not change storage outcome but reorders events; no observable behavioral change detected — EXCLUDED.
